description: Save markup over a photo as a new layer version: arrows, lines, boxes, circles, text and freehand strokes in 0..1 photo coordinates (0,0 is top left). The photo is never changed; earlier versions are kept. An empty list clears the markup.

points.description: [x, y] pairs from 0 to 1. Text: 1 point. Freehand: 2 to 500. Others: 2 (start and end, or two corners).

name: media_saveMarkup
